name: Hija de Sanchez
recommendation: The story is that a chef of Mexican descent from Chicago was working as a pastry chef at Noma and over the years just couldn’t get over the relative desert that was the Copenhagen food scene when it came to Mexican food. So she opened a taco stand and it started a Mexican food movement in Copenhagen. We now have quite a few very decent Mexican food places, but Hija de Sanchez is by far the best and their Pastor tacos are amazing. Try the 3-taco deal with Hibiscus lemonade, and make sure to get some extra of that delicious jalapeno and/or habanero salsa, depending on how hot you want your tacos of course.
